description: List the media partners (publishers) running on the brand's programme at FirstPromoter. Use this when the user asks "who is promoting us on FirstPromoter?", "which publishers are active on our programme?", or wants an outbound roster. Returns MediaPartner records with normalised status; pair with the matching get_programme_performance tool on FirstPromoter to drill into per-publisher performance.
name: affiliate_firstpromoter_list_media_partners
